d:
Former Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan has written an open letter to the chief justices of Pakistan's top courts, seeking proper medical treatment for himself and his wife, Bushra Bibi.
In the letter, Khan claimed that he was being kept in solitary confinement for up to 22 hours a day and was being denied regular access to his family and lawyers.
He also claimed that he had lost 85% of the vision in his right eye and that his blood pressure had reached dangerously high levels.
